hypothesis: On the published characteristic-zero Hilbert-function example, retaining the original regular-sequence degrees instead of inflating them to satisfy the old growth condition reduces the total computed graded Betti budget by at least 20 percent. A case already covered by the old condition has identical exact-degree and baseline budgets. Two independently organized exact Koszul computations agree on every computed entry.

input.exposure: Example and published tables read before specification; known-benchmark calibration, not blind validation or a newly discovered application
input.coefficient_field: rational exact arithmetic; theorem use conditional on characteristic zero and a real regular-sequence certificate

baseline: Same Hilbert data with an ordinary lex ideal, an old degree-growth-admissible LPP ideal, and the exact-degree LPP ideal. No solver runtime benefit predicted.
judge: Integer sparse elimination on the ordinary-degree Koszul complex versus separate Fraction Gaussian elimination on every bounded multidegree. Exact lcm Hilbert numerator equality certifies the entire infinite Hilbert sequence; full multidegree support bounded by generator coordinate maxima. Boundary complete intersection has its independently known Koszul Betti table.
failure: Any oracle or all-degree Hilbert disagreement, less than20 percent budget reduction on the declared published case, or a nonzero old-scope control difference. Unsupported assumptions stay outside application scope.
metrics: all graded ideal and quotient Betti entries
total Betti budget by homological degree
limits: A conditional symbolic-computation budget prototype and replication of a known published example. No explicit original ideal generators or independently verified regular-sequence certificate are supplied by the benchmark. Does not prove the2026 theorem, establish general tightness, validate all geometric dependencies, certify positive characteristic, or improve Groebner/syzygy solver speed or memory. Monomial-only comparisons were already known.
